title: General.
officialText:
In the process of installing or repairing any part of a plumbing and drainage installation, the finished floors, walls,
ceilings, tile work or any other part of the building or premises that must be changed or replaced shall be left in a safe structural
condition in accordance with the requirements of the New York City Building Code.
